# AstryxIcon { #anylumino.AstryxIcon }

```python
AstryxIcon(icon, **props)
```

Render an Astryx icon by name.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                      | Default    |
|---------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| icon    | str    | Astryx icon name.                                                                                                                                                                                | _required_ |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Icon props. Useful keys: color, size, className, and style. The icon argument names the Astryx icon to render. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Icon>. | `{}`       |
